title: Localization preserves projective dimension and finite global dimension
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $S\subseteq R$ a multiplicative subset, $S^{-1}R$ the ring of fractions and, for an $R$-module $M$, $S^{-1}M$ the $S^{-1}R$-module of fractions $m/s$ [def-weil-pbc-module-localization]; let $n\ge0$. (1) If $M$ has a projective resolution of length $\le n$ over $R$ [def-weil-pbc-finite-global-dimension], that is, an exact sequence $0\to P_n\to\dots\to P_0\to M\to0$ with every $P_i$ a projective $R$-module [def-weil-pbc-projective-module], then $S^{-1}M$ has a projective resolution of length $\le n$ over $S^{-1}R$. (2) If $R$ has global dimension $\le n$ [def-weil-pbc-finite-global-dimension], then $S^{-1}R$ has global dimension $\le n$; in particular, if $R$ has finite global dimension then so has $S^{-1}R$, with $\operatorname{gl.dim}S^{-1}R\le\operatorname{gl.dim}R$.

source.place: Algebra, Lemma Tag 00O8 (lemma-localize-finite-gl-dim, line 26881), with its proof (localization is exact, Proposition 00CS; $S^{-1}P$ projective for $P$ projective, Lemma 05A3 ascend-properties-modules; $M'=S^{-1}M'$ for an $S^{-1}R$-module $M'$)

proof.text: Apply CategoryTheory.Functor.mapProjectiveResolution to the exact localization functor ModuleCat.localizedModuleFunctor S. This functor preserves homology by exactness [lem-weil-pbc-localization-module-exact], so the mapped augmentation is a quasi-isomorphism. Its terms are the shrunk localized modules [def-weil-pbc-module-localization] and its complex is the termwise mapped original projective resolution [def-weil-pbc-finite-global-dimension, def-weil-pbc-exact-sequence].

source.place: Algebra, Lemma Tag 00O8 (lemma-localize-finite-gl-dim, line 26881), proof, first sentence ('As localization is exact, see Proposition 00CS')

proof.text: The localization functor preserves projective objects [lem-weil-pbc-localization-projective, def-weil-pbc-projective-module], as supplied by Mathlib.RingTheory.LocalProperties.ProjectiveDimension. Functor.map_isZero sends each zero term above n to a zero term. Thus the mapped projective resolution has the original bound [def-weil-pbc-finite-global-dimension]. Transport its augmentation along the isomorphism Shrink.linearEquiv (Localization S) (LocalizedModule S M) to obtain a resolution of the unshrunk localized module. Transport keeps the complex and its vanishing terms unchanged.

source.place: Algebra, Lemma Tag 00O8 (lemma-localize-finite-gl-dim, line 26881), proof, first sentence ('as each $S^{-1}P_i$ is a projective $S^{-1}R$-module, see Lemma 05A3 ... This proves (1)')

proof.text: For any module M over Localization S, install the restricted R-module structure Module.compHom M (algebraMap R (Localization S)) and its scalar tower. Apply the assumed uniform resolution bound to ModuleCat.of R M and then the localized-resolution result of the preceding step. Use isLocalizedModule_id S M (Localization S), IsLocalizedModule.iso S LinearMap.id and LinearEquiv.extendScalarsOfIsLocalization to identify LocalizedModule S M with M [lem-weil-pbc-localization-module-over-localization, def-weil-pbc-module-localization]. Compose the resolution augmentation with this isomorphism, leaving the projective complex unchanged. This proves the bound for every localized-ring module [def-weil-pbc-finite-global-dimension].

source.place: Algebra, Lemma Tag 00O8 (lemma-localize-finite-gl-dim, line 26881), proof, second paragraph ('Let $M'$ be an $S^{-1}R$-module. Note that $M' = S^{-1}M'$. Hence we see that (2) follows from (1).')

proof.text: For a finite-global-dimension witness h, Nat.find_spec h supplies the uniform bound globalDimension R h [def-weil-pbc-finite-global-dimension]. Apply the uniform localization bound proved above at this integer to obtain a finite-global-dimension witness hS for Localization S. Nat.find_min' hS gives globalDimension (Localization S) hS ≤ globalDimension R h. All three clauses are combined without any new intermediate sorry.

lean.statement: theorem localization_preserves_projective_and_global_dimension (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (S : Submonoid R) (n : ℕ) : (∀ M : ModuleCat.{max u v} R, ModuleCat.HasProjectiveResolutionLE M n → ModuleCat.HasProjectiveResolutionLE (ModuleCat.of (Localization S) (LocalizedModule S M)) n) ∧ (HasGlobalDimensionLE.{u, max u v} R n → HasGlobalDimensionLE.{u, max u v} (Localization S) n) ∧ (∀ h : HasFiniteGlobalDimension.{u, max u v} R, ∃ hS : HasFiniteGlobalDimension.{u, max u v} (Localization S), globalDimension.{u, max u v} (Localization S) hS ≤ globalDimension.{u, max u v} R h)
